browse.title: Courses

browse.empty: When your institution adds courses for your term they appear here. You can also turn your own notes into a course.

new.teacherHint: The teacher can edit the course and see its results.

settings.privateHint: Classmates in your program can open it once it's ready. They can't change it.
settings.shareHint: Students in these terms see this course too — useful for revision or advanced students.
settings.rebuildHint: Open the course builder to add material or split it again.
settings.archiveHint: Hides the course from everyone. You can restore it any time.
